Chapter 1115 34: 500 Years (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1115 34: 500 Years (Seeking Subscription)

"I'll give it a try."

Lin Yuan continued to speak.

The enhancement of the internal universe within the Taiji Primordial Spirit was so significant that even he couldn't quite grasp it.

Anyway, it definitely surpassed the internal universe of his true body.

Lin Yuan wanted to know what level the internal universe of the current Taiji Primordial Spirit was at.

And to find an opponent for comparison? Given the strength of Lin Yuan's Taiji Primordial Spirit's internal universe, an ordinary Chaos Venerable probably wouldn't withstand even a moment.

"Since the master wants to try again, then let's try again."

The red-clothed girl did not stop him. In the strictest sense, Lin Yuan was her master, and she had to comply with any decision he made.

"Master, please take a look."

The red-clothed girl turned her hand, and that massive piece of eternal fine gold appeared once more.

"Master, please start."

The red-clothed girl looked at Lin Yuan.

"Not trying it here in this internal universe."

Lin Yuan said, "Let's try it in the internal universe of my Primordial Spirit."

"Huh?"

The red-clothed girl was a bit stunned.

As the Spirit of Jade Gourd created by a Thirteenth Order life form, the red-clothed girl also knew that Lin Yuan had cultivated two major Primordial Spirits.

However, the two major Primordial Spirits were far weaker than Lin Yuan's true body, and their internal universes were the same.

If Lin Yuan wanted to try the eternal fine gold with the internal universe of the Primordial Spirit, he probably wouldn't even leave a ten-centimeter mark.

"Alright."

Although puzzled, the red-clothed girl did not question him, only silently thinking to herself, "Could the master be testing how weak the internal universe of the Primordial Spirit is?"

Swoosh!

The next moment.

Lin Yuan brought the red-clothed girl and that piece of eternal fine gold into the internal universe of the Taiji Primordial Spirit.

"Where is this?"

The red-clothed girl was initially unconcerned, but soon realized something was amiss.

Why was the internal universe of the master's Primordial Spirit so stable, giving the red-clothed girl a sense of oppression far surpassing that of the true body's internal universe?

"I haven't cultivated the second layer of 'Infinite Void'..."

The red-clothed girl immediately observed closely. If the internal universe had cultivated the second layer of 'Infinite Void,' she could tell from the basic structural differences of the internal universe.

"I'm starting." Lin Yuan looked at the floating eternal fine gold in the distance and began to mobilize the Origin Power of the universe to suppress it.

Rumble.

Endless Origin Power gathered, and in the center of the universe, the constantly burning Fierce Sun also began to heat up, with the terrifying aura starting to spread.

After merging and devouring the Origin of Fierce Sun, the Taiji Universe, with the Origin of Fierce Sun as the core, still fundamentally based on Taiyin Taiyang Taiji.

At this moment, with the Taiji Universe running at full power, it was basically equivalent to the Divine Skill 'Fierce Sun Opening the Sky' without a burden, and in terms of power, it exceeded it by far, like a combination of the Taiji Universe and 'Fierce Sun Opening the Sky.'

Buzz buzz buzz!

Every ounce of power from the Taiji Universe fully suppressed the piece of eternal fine gold.

In an instant.

The eternal fine gold began to deform and twist visibly, with terrifying marks appearing on its surface, spreading deep and forming pits.

Each pit exceeded one meter, with the deepest approaching two meters.

The entire piece of eternal fine gold became uneven, looking somewhat 'miserable.'

"So hard."

Seeing this, Lin Yuan couldn't help but marvel.

Although he wasn't sure how strong the internal universe of the Taiji Primordial Spirit was.

But under the full operation and suppression just now, dozens or hundreds of Chaos Realm peak Venerables would be annihilated without a doubt.

But this piece of eternal fine gold? It only became slightly uneven?

"The deepest mark exceeds one meter, approaching two meters."

Lin Yuan glanced at the eternal fine gold and then looked at the red-clothed girl, "So, what level is this universe equivalent to?"

"...."

The red-clothed girl fell silent.

As soon as she entered this universe, she noticed something was off, then she felt the terrifying power that erupted when Lin Yuan operated the internal universe at full force.

Finally, that piece of eternal fine gold rapidly deformed and twisted.

"Master, why is the internal universe of your Primordial Spirit so powerful?"

The red-clothed girl took a deep breath, then looked at Lin Yuan with incredulity.

If not for the certainty that this universe originated from Lin Yuan, with their auras imprinted together, the red-clothed girl might have suspected it wasn't the internal universe of another powerful figure.

Too outrageous.

Too extreme.

"How is this possible? This universe hasn't cultivated the second layer of 'Infinite Void,' still remaining at the first layer, why is it so strong?"

The red-clothed girl was full of confusion, the scene before her was simply unbelievable.

"I've made some improvements to the internal universe." Lin Yuan thought for a moment, not mentioning the 'Fierce Sun Opening the Sky' to the red-clothed girl.

After all, it involved another dimensional space.

Actually, Lin Yuan had hidden the existence of the Fierce Sun at the center of the universe when he brought the red-clothed girl over, and not only that, he deliberately suppressed the Power of Fierce Sun when operating the internal universe at full force.

The internal universe was Lin Yuan's domain. As long as Lin Yuan didn't want to, even the red-clothed girl couldn't see through much.

Earlier, the red-clothed girl could detect whether Lin Yuan was cultivating the second layer of 'Infinite Void' because Lin Yuan actively showed it to her.

"Improvements?"

The red-clothed girl was shocked. The internal universe cultivated through 'Infinite Void' had already reached perfection at the microscopic level; could it be improved further?

If it weren't for the terrifying enhancement of this inner universe, the red-clothed girl wouldn't have believed it at all.

"Right."

Lin Yuan nodded, "Now, to what level has my inner universe reached?"

Lin Yuan looked expectantly at the red-clothed girl.

Earlier, the red-clothed girl mentioned that leaving a half-meter mark on the Eternal Fine Gold meant that the inner universe was nearing completion of the second layer of "Infinite Void."

By then, Lin Yuan's inner universe would be the strongest just below the perfect Chaos Realm.

But now?

Lin Yuan not only left a half-meter mark!

The deepest mark was almost two meters.

"Master, this inner universe should be able to rival the perfect Chaos Realm."

The red-clothed girl said.

Perfect Chaos Realm, which is the Chaos Great Saint.

In other words, Lin Yuan's Taiji Primordial Spirit's inner universe can now be compared to the Chaos Great Saint's inner universe.

"My Primordial Spirit's inner universe is inherently weaker than the true body's inner universe. If the improvement method is applied to the true body's inner universe, wouldn't it be stronger than an average Chaos Great Saint in terms of inner universe?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Of course, being stronger in the inner universe does not mean having stronger combat power than a Chaos Great Saint.

A Chaos Great Saint's strength and power depend on multiple aspects; the inner universe is just one of them.

But anyway, Lin Yuan can now challenge a Chaos Great Saint to some extent.

Challenging doesn't mean comparing or equaling but being able to exchange a few moves.

You must know the gap between a Chaos Great Saint and a Chaos Venerable is immense; the aftermath of a casual strike from a Chaos Great Saint could severely injure a Chaos Venerable.

That Lin Yuan can challenge and exchange a few moves with a Chaos Great Saint almost makes him invincible among Chaos Venerables.

Even this is just the beginning; Lin Yuan has many techniques yet to be cultivated to the extreme. For instance, he hasn't mastered the second layer of "Infinite Void."

If Lin Yuan reaches the peak in all aspects, he could fully stand against a Great Saint.

To face a Chaos Great Saint with the body of an Epoch Dominator.

Note that even in the Source World, the core royal family with extremely rich Ancestor of Fierce Sun bloodline can at most challenge a Heavenly Venerate at the Great Lord level.

That is already the limit, the strongest Great Lord created by the synergy of the thirteenth-tier bloodline and thirteenth-tier legacy.

As for a Dominator facing a Heavenly Venerate? Unless the thirteenth tier possesses the body, or other external forces assist, it's just a delusion.

This is true for the Source World and also for this Chaos Void.

Under normal circumstances, even with the "Infinite Void" thirteenth-tier legacy, at most, one can challenge a Venerate at the Dominator level.

Even if one not only obtains the "Infinite Void" but also accumulates several other legacies representing body, soul, etc., all at the thirteenth tier.

At best, one could barely challenge a peak Chaos Realm Venerate as a Dominator; as for a Great Saint? At least stepping into the Chaos Realm is necessary.

No essential difference from the core royal family of the Source World.

But Lin Yuan?

The accumulation and foundation in all aspects have created such a monstrous genius.

"Master, your future might reach the heights of the former master."

The red-clothed girl looked at Lin Yuan with a slightly complex tone.

Actually, the creator of "Infinite Void" left behind the thirteenth-tier legacies representing foundation, base, physical body, and so on, just casually.

There was no intention to cultivate a thirteenth tier.

Life at the thirteenth tier isn't something that can be cultivated.

To be precise, life at the thirteenth tier can't be cultivated.

However, at this moment, Lin Yuan gives the red-clothed girl an illusion that there is truly hope to break into the thirteenth tier in the future.

"Too far away."

Lin Yuan shook his head. The more he cultivates, the more he feels the difficulty of stepping into the thirteenth tier.

Even if everything goes smoothly and he cultivates to perfection in the Chaos Realm, how would he face the cycle of time?

...

Determining the level of the Taiji Primordial Spirit's inner universe.

Lin Yuan then began to continue trying with the two major Primordial Spirits again; as for the true body? There's no rush for now. He'll consider the true body after the inner universes of the two major Primordial Spirits successfully gather the Origin Source of Fierce Sun.

...

Source World.

The war between the Qingfen Domain and the Purple Dream Domain continues.

The Yishisan defensive line battlefield.

After a routine clash with Great Venerate Changfeng, Lin Yuan retreated.

"Hmm?"

Lin Yuan looked up toward the core defensive line battlefield, seeing more than ten peak Great Lords in a chaotic melee, their forces colliding and distorting space and time.

"These peak Great Lords are really giving it their all."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In a war involving dozens of major domains, if ordinary Great Lords and seasoned veteran Great Lords might still have the possibility of slacking off.

But peak Great Lords?

Peak Great Lords can completely refuse to participate if unwilling. Since they're here, they must have been given irresistible promises by the royal families who have crowned kings.

So there's a real possibility of true passion igniting between peak Great Lords, as every peak Great Lord desires to win the war.

Only in this way can the royal family fulfill their promise.

If they fail? Even if there's a 'minimum' reward guarantee, it's certainly far less than winning the war.

...

Time passes slowly.

Five hundred years pass in the blink of an eye.
